requiredInputs: An anonymized coding-job ZIP generated by IQB-ScanManager
The result-file schema or an independently checked reference result
UI selectors obtained from a real Windows probe

assertions: Each known test case receives its expected code
The result file contains all completed assignments
Assignments and current progress survive restart
An already coded case is reachable
The revised code replaces the old code without duplicate results
The program prevents navigation past the first uncoded case
The result file records the test coder
An invalid job is rejected without a crash
No missing, extra, or duplicate assignments occur
